title: 7G Rainbow Colony
desc: Kadhir, an unemployed young man, falls in love with Anita and persistently pursues her. However, Anita insists that they can only be together if he gets his life in order.

title: Swayamvaram
desc: Initially at odds, Venu and Anu find themselves in love when they keep meeting each other due to a common friend, Bose, who incidentally is also in love with Anu.

title: Vaali
desc: Deva, a man with a hearing and speech impairment, secretly loves his twin brother's wife, Priya. He tries his best to separate the two, to the extent of following them on their honeymoon.

title: Devi
desc: Devi, a snake goddess, vows to protect the daughter of the man who died while trying to save her from a powerful demon. However, she falls in love with a human, unaware of the consequences.

title: Yaaradi Nee Mohini
desc: Vasu, a young man with dreams of starting a business, falls for Keerthi, who is already engaged to his friend Cheenu, creating a love triangle that tests their friendships and emotions.
